fields.says: `tests/unit/lin-4469-prompt-folds.test.js`: the describe says the folded spellings "appear in no rendered prompt", but each test asserts `where.length <= 1`, so a retired phrase left in one template or Periodical still passes. None renders anywhere at 877f32cb4. Fix: assert `where.length === 0` and drop "at most one" from the test name. (LIN-4469 blind read.)

`lib/periodicals.js`: `committedSearch` closes its own parenthesis, and Stability's bullet strips it again with `capitalised(committedSearch(...)).slice(0, -1)` to add its own "; look beside ...)". One caller undoes the helper's output shape, so changing the helper's wording silently breaks Stability. Fix: give `committedSearch` an optional tail for the parenthetical (e.g. `(what, more = '')` -> `(no path is written here${more})`) and drop the slice. (LIN-4469 blind read.)

Fix with finding-166: correct the header comment (or route that bullet through the helper and re-pin its hash). (LIN-4469 blind read.)
